title: Layer3Rule
description: A single rule in the Layer 3 production rule engine. Part of RS(S) for S in {SAFE, CAUTION}. RS(UNSAFE) = empty set — no rule object may have applicable_state='UNSAFE'.

applicable_state.description: The safety state S for which this rule belongs to RS(S). 'UNSAFE' is not permitted: RS(UNSAFE) = empty set, enforced by rule_repository.py which refuses any rule with applicable_state not in {'SAFE','CAUTION'}.

conditions.description: List of condition predicate descriptors. All conditions in a rule are evaluated as a conjunction (AND). CONTENT IS OPEN-L3-1 — no authoritative rule antecedents exist; schema structure is defined and ready to receive scientifically specified content.

variable.description: Name of the field in DecisionContext to evaluate (e.g. 'resolved_w', 'resolved_o_wave_height', 'resolved_r_rate', 'vessel_category'). Must not introduce a new scientific variable not present in canonical E or the decision context.

value.description: Threshold, set, or string value. Null when operator is 'is_none' or 'is_not_none'. Numeric values use the canonical unit for the variable (knots for w, mm/hr for r_rate, metres for o_wave_height, hours 24-hr for t).

conclusion_type.description: The recommendation type R produced when all conditions fire. Invariant: for applicable_state='CAUTION', conclusion_type must be in {'Go','Delay'} — enforced by validate_rule_set() in rule_set_provider.py which checks ConclusionTypes(RS_candidate) subset-of A_AI(state). For applicable_state='SAFE', all four types are permitted.

conclusion_payload.description: Type-specific payload providing the content of the recommendation (e.g. a suggested departure time for DepartureTime, a duration in hours for Duration). CONTENT IS OPEN-L3-1 — payload schema depends on scientifically specified rule content.

provenance.description: Source reference for this rule's scientific authority (e.g. a document path, domain expert specification reference, or authority section). Must not be empty. Rules without traceable provenance must not be added to the repository.

enabled.description: Whether this rule is active in the repository. Disabled rules (enabled=false) are excluded from RS(S) during select_rule_set().

x-invariants.caution_restriction: Any rule with applicable_state='CAUTION' MUST have conclusion_type in {'Go','Delay'}. Enforced at supply time by validate_rule_set() before any reasoning begins — not post-hoc filtered.
x-invariants.safe_permitted_types: Any rule with applicable_state='SAFE' may have conclusion_type in {'Go','Delay','DepartureTime','Duration'}.
x-invariants.no_unsafe_rules: RS(UNSAFE) = empty set. No rule object exists with applicable_state='UNSAFE'. The UNSAFE path does not supply a rule set to Layer 3.
x-invariants.content_status: OPEN-L3-1 — Concrete conditions and conclusion_payload values require scientific specification before any rule is added to the repository. Do not invent predicates such as 'IF wave < 1.0 AND rain < 10 THEN Go' from Layer 2 thresholds.
x-invariants.algorithm_correspondence: algorithm-specification.md §17 (Algorithm 3 supply contract); §19 (Algorithm 4 engine contract); appendix-c-formalisation.md C.7.2 (Safety Dominance proof by construction); evaluation-specification.md §7 (F1, F2).
